photo.facebook:
The silver spot chart is never the price you pay. Spot is the baseline from COMEX futures, updating 23 hours a day. Your real cost is total paid divided by troy ounces received. A $36 coin at $32 spot is a 12.5% premium. Online dealers run 3-8% over spot, coin shops up to 18%. Knowing how to read the chart and the premium together is the whole game.

Do you check the spot chart before every silver purchase, or do you just buy on a schedule and ignore it?
